title: Snake escape
tagline: Grab the cash, dodge the snake, reach the exit.
teaser: Collect money around the room while a snake slithers after you, then slip out through the exit before it catches up.

manPage.synopsis: snake — collect, keep clear of the snake, escape.
manPage.description: A chase from the 1980 BSD games: a six-square snake follows you while you pick up money and look for the way out.

howToPlay: Move around the room collecting money.
Keep away from the snake chasing you.
Slip out through the exit before it catches you.
